title: Ops Pack body
description: Notification routing table consumed by the Alerts & Notifications module (load_ops_routing + route).
$comment: route() reads routes.get(sev, default) with a hard-coded 'ticket' fallback (alerts/module.py:117-123), and load_ops_routing reads routes/default/runbook independently (alerts/module.py:135-158). So default-only, routes-only, or both are all valid; at least one must be present.

default.description: Fallback channel when a severity has no explicit route.

routes.description: Map of Severity -> channel (e.g. none | ticket | email | page).

runbook.description: Runbook link surfaced with routed notifications; null/absent is skipped via a truthy check (alerts/module.py:157). 'default' and 'routes' stay strict — a fallback policy must carry a real value.
